frappe-gantt 1.2.2
Vendored from npm frappe-gantt@1.2.2 (MIT).
- frappe-gantt.js     = UMD (lazy via $.getScript / window.Gantt)
- frappe-gantt.esm.js = ESM (available for future bundling)
- CSS: dist/css/frappe-gantt.css
Spike notes (2026-07-29):
- on_click / on_date_change / on_progress_change / on_view_change still work via trigger_event → options["on_"+event]
- language uses Intl.DateTimeFormat → 'pt-BR' works without patch
- holidays / ignore / readonly / readonly_dates / readonly_progress / move_dependencies / show_expected_progress / today_button / view_mode_select / container_height:auto / scroll_to all present
- popup API is function({task, chart, set_title, set_subtitle, set_details, add_action})
